content.short: BrandSensed is a Cardano-based loyalty project built around the BRND token and brand discovery rewards.
content.description: BrandSensed positions BRND as a native Cardano token designed to reward brand discovery and brand loyalty. The project describes its platform as a way to unlock value between individuals, retailers, and brands by using blockchain incentives to represent, share, and engage with brand relationships. In that model, BRND acts as the token layer for participation in the BrandSensed ecosystem, where loyalty and discovery are intended to become measurable and rewardable on-chain.
